turns.user: Explain why a load balancer sends requests to several servers.
turns.assistant:
Load balancer spread requests many servers. Reasons:

**No single server melt.** One server handle limited traffic. Too many requests at once = slow or crash. Split load = each server handle small share.

**Speed.** Requests wait in line. More servers = more lines = shorter wait each user.

**Survive failure.** One server die, balancer stop sending it work, route to healthy ones. Users notice nothing.

**Grow easy.** Traffic grow? Add more servers behind balancer. No rebuild.

Analogy: one grocery checkout = long line. Ten checkouts + person directing shoppers to open lane = fast, and one register break, rest keep going.
